metadata.topic: Jurassic Park and Jurassic World films
metadata.focus: Facts about the films' characters, actors, dinosaurs and plots, each tied to a specific film. Make about half the statements false by changing one specific detail (year, name, number, place) so the error is clear-cut. One clear declarative statement, not a question.

questions.question: In Jurassic World (2015), Bryce Dallas Howard plays the park's operations manager, Claire Dearing.
questions.explanation: Bryce Dallas Howard plays Claire Dearing, who runs Jurassic World's operations, opposite Chris Pratt's Owen Grady.
questions.fact: Bryce Dallas Howard plays Claire Dearing, the operations manager of the park in Jurassic World (2015).

questions.question: In the original Jurassic Park (1993), the paleontologist Dr. Alan Grant is played by Jeff Goldblum.
questions.explanation: Sam Neill plays Dr. Alan Grant, while Jeff Goldblum plays the mathematician Dr. Ian Malcolm.
questions.fact: Sam Neill plays Dr. Alan Grant in Jurassic Park (1993).

questions.question: Steven Spielberg directed Jurassic Park III (2001).
questions.explanation: Jurassic Park III was directed by Joe Johnston, and it was the first film in the franchise not directed by Spielberg.
questions.fact: Jurassic Park III (2001) was directed by Joe Johnston.

questions.question: Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom (2018) was directed by J. A. Bayona.
questions.explanation: Spanish filmmaker J. A. Bayona directed Fallen Kingdom, taking over from Colin Trevorrow, who directed Jurassic World.
questions.fact: J. A. Bayona directed Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom (2018).

questions.question: Jurassic World Rebirth (2025), starring Scarlett Johansson, was directed by Gareth Edwards.
questions.explanation: Gareth Edwards directed Jurassic World Rebirth from a script by David Koepp, with Scarlett Johansson in the lead.
questions.fact: Jurassic World Rebirth (2025) was directed by Gareth Edwards and stars Scarlett Johansson.

questions.question: In Jurassic Park III (2001), the missing boy whom Paul and Amanda Kirby are searching for on Isla Sorna is named Billy.
questions.explanation: The Kirbys' missing son is Eric, while Billy Brennan is Alan Grant's young assistant.
questions.fact: In Jurassic Park III, Paul and Amanda Kirby search Isla Sorna for their son Eric Kirby.

questions.question: The original Jurassic Park film (1993) was based on a novel by Stephen King.
questions.explanation: Jurassic Park (1993) was adapted from Michael Crichton's 1990 novel of the same name, not from a Stephen King book.
questions.fact: The film Jurassic Park (1993) is based on the 1990 novel Jurassic Park by Michael Crichton.

questions.question: Jurassic World (2015) was directed by Colin Trevorrow.
questions.explanation: Colin Trevorrow directed Jurassic World (2015) and later returned to direct Jurassic World Dominion (2022).
questions.fact: Colin Trevorrow directed the 2015 film Jurassic World.

questions.question: In the original Jurassic Park (1993), the paleobotanist Dr. Ellie Sattler is played by Laura Dern.
questions.explanation: Laura Dern played Ellie Sattler in Jurassic Park (1993) and returned to the role in Jurassic Park III and Jurassic World Dominion.
questions.fact: Laura Dern plays Dr. Ellie Sattler in Jurassic Park (1993).

questions.question: In the original Jurassic Park (1993), park founder John Hammond is played by Anthony Hopkins.
questions.explanation: John Hammond was played by Richard Attenborough, not Anthony Hopkins.
questions.fact: Richard Attenborough plays John Hammond in Jurassic Park (1993).

questions.question: Jurassic World Dominion (2022) held its world premiere in Rio de Janeiro.
questions.explanation: Jurassic World Dominion premiered in Mexico City on May 23, 2022, not in Rio de Janeiro.
questions.fact: Jurassic World Dominion premiered in Mexico City on May 23, 2022.

questions.question: Jurassic World Rebirth (2025) was written by David Koepp, who also co-wrote the screenplay of the original Jurassic Park (1993).
questions.explanation: David Koepp co-wrote Jurassic Park (1993) with Michael Crichton, wrote The Lost World (1997) and returned to write Jurassic World Rebirth.
questions.fact: David Koepp wrote Jurassic World Rebirth (2025) and co-wrote the screenplay of Jurassic Park (1993).
